title: The fundraiser link “closes tonight”
scenario: A popular student posts that the club fundraiser is short of its goal and shares a new payment link that closes tonight. The cause is real, but the link is not the one the school used last week.

answers.A: Donate only through the school or club’s confirmed payment channel after checking the new link is approved.
answers.B: Ask the club adviser or treasurer through a known channel whether the payment link changed.
answers.C: Donate because the fundraiser itself is definitely real and the amount is small.

explanation: Real causes can be used to redirect money. Verify the payment destination, not just the story.
proTip: True cause, wrong link = wrong destination.
